title: Sam and the Action Song
text:
Sam likes songs with actions. In the song, you clap your hands and jump. Sam sings and claps with his friends at school.

The teacher plays the piano. The children stand up and move their arms. Then they sit down and smile.

questions.text: What do you do in the song?
How does Sam feel about the songs?
Why do the children move their arms?

vocabulary.definition: hit your hands together to make a sound
push your body up off the ground with your legs
a large musical instrument with black and white keys

paragraph_translations: Sam gosta de músicas com ações. Na música, você bate palmas e pula. Sam canta e bate palmas com os amigos na escola.
A professora toca piano. As crianças se levantam e movem os braços. Depois sentam e sorriem.
